title: Observability: ioctl_init logs empty provider name when no provider hint given
description: In crypto2dev_fd.c:713-717, the success log 'init dispatched to provider' copies op.provider (the user-supplied hint string) into state->provider_name before logging it. When the caller passes an empty provider string (the normal case), the log emits: init('cbc(aes)') dispatched to provider ''. A support engineer reading the ring buffer post-incident cannot determine which actual provider handled the session. The selected provider name is available from the registry entry returned by crypto2dev_lookup_algo but is not captured.
